# Trees and Tents

> A comprehensive resource for backpacking guides, hiking trails, outdoor gear recommendations, and trail-inspired merchandise across California and the Pacific Northwest.

Trees and Tents provides detailed trail guides for major backpacking routes including the High Sierra Trail, Trans-Catalina Trail, and Grand Canyon Rim to Rim, alongside practical gear guides and a curated shop of outdoor merchandise. The site serves both beginner and experienced hikers with trail recommendations, seasonal hiking tips, and trail-themed stickers.

## Key Topics

- High Sierra Trail
- Trans-Catalina Trail
- Grand Canyon Rim to Rim
- Three Sisters Loop
- Lost Coast Trail
- Skyline to the Sea Trail
- backpacking guides
- hiking gear
- Bay Area trails
- winter hiking
- urban hikes
- trail stickers
- budget-friendly gear
- San Francisco hiking
- seasonal hiking tips

## Trail Guides & Backpacking

- [Trail Guides Hub](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide): Main trail guides hub covering Bay Area trails and backpacking routes
- [High Sierra Trail Backpacking Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/backpacking-high-sierra-trail): Comprehensive backpacking guide for High Sierra Trail in Sequoia NP
- [Trans-Catalina Trail Backpacking Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/backpacking-trans-catalina-trail): Multi-day backpacking guide for Trans-Catalina Trail on Catalina Island
- [Grand Canyon Rim to Rim Trail Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/grand-canyon-rim-to-rim): Trail guide for Grand Canyon Rim to Rim backpacking adventure
- [Skyline to the Sea Trail Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/backpacking-skyline-to-the-sea-trail): Beginner backpacking guide for Skyline to Sea Trail in Santa Cruz Mtns
- [Three Sisters Loop Backpacking Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/backpacking-the-three-sisters-loop-from-devils-lake-trailhead): Backpacking guide for Three Sisters Loop in Oregon's Cascade Range
- [Lost Coast Trail Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/trailguide/backpacking-lost-coast): Trail guide for Lost Coast backpacking trip in California

## Hiking Gear Guides

- [Gear Guide Hub](https://www.treesandtents.com/gearguide): Comprehensive gear guide with reviews of hiking essentials and equipment
- [Winter Hiking Gear Guide](https://www.treesandtents.com/gearguide/winter-hiking-gear-for-snowy-adventures): Winter hiking gear guide with layering systems and cold-weather clothing
- [Stay Warm on Fall Backpacking Trips](https://www.treesandtents.com/gearguide/ten-easy-tips-stay-warm-on-fall-backpacking-trips): Beginner tips for staying warm during fall backpacking shoulder season
- [Budget-Friendly Hiker Gift Ideas](https://www.treesandtents.com/gearguide/inexpensive-gift-ideas-for-hikers): Budget-friendly gift guide for hikers under $20 with product recommendations

## Blog & Hiking Tips

- [10 Best Urban Hikes in San Francisco](https://www.treesandtents.com/blogpost/10-best-urban-hikes-in-san-francisco): Blog guide to 10 best urban hikes in San Francisco with trail recommendations
